grammar: n. 学习者；学习某种技能的人。可数名词，动词 learn。
collocations: a language learner; young learners; learner of English
commonMistake: learner 指正在学习的人；learn 是动词，learning 可指学习过程，不能互换词性。

example.english: A patient learner practised the new words for ten minutes each day.
example.chinese: 一位有耐心的学习者每天练习这些新词十分钟。

application.prompt: A good language ___ reviews mistakes and tries the sentence again. A. learner B. learning
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；a good 后需要表示“学习者”的名词 learner。

grammar: n. 学习卡片；抽认卡。可数名词，复数 flashcards。
collocations: make flashcards; review with a flashcard; a set of flashcards
commonMistake: flashcard 是卡片，复数加 -s；不要和 flash drive（闪存盘）混淆。

example.english: I wrote one new word on each flashcard and practised with a friend.
example.chinese: 我在每张抽认卡上写一个新词，然后和朋友一起练习。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses flashcard correctly in a study context? A. Mei made a flashcard for each new word. B. Mei made a flashcards for each new word.
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；a 后用单数 flashcard；flashcards 是复数形式。

grammar: n. 专题研究；项目。可数名词；v. 预测或投射。
collocations: a science project; work on a project; project costs
commonMistake: project 作学校任务时是可数名词；projected 是动词过去分词或形容词，不可用来表示一个项目。

example.english: Our science project tests whether sunlight helps seeds grow faster.
example.chinese: 我们的科学项目研究阳光是否能让种子长得更快。

application.prompt: The class worked in groups to prepare a science ___ about clean water. A. projector B. project
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；小组共同准备的是一项 science project（科学项目）。

grammar: n. 网站。可数名词，复数 websites。
collocations: visit a website; website address; official website
commonMistake: website 指网站本身，web page 指网站中的单个网页；拼写通常合写为一个词。

example.english: The school website posts homework and schedule changes.
example.chinese: 学校网站会发布作业和日程变更。

application.prompt: The library put its opening hours on the ___ so students could check them at home. A. web B. website
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；学生在家查询开放时间要访问图书馆网站 website。

grammar: adj. 动手实践的；实际操作的。通常作名词前定语。
collocations: hands-on activity; hands-on experience; hands-on learning
commonMistake: hands-on 作复合形容词时用连字符；不能作副词修饰动词，如 hands-on learn。

example.english: The hands-on lesson let students build a simple radio.
example.chinese: 这堂实践课让学生亲手组装了一台简易收音机。

application.prompt: The museum offers a ___ workshop where children can make their own models. A. hands-on B. hand-on
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；修饰 workshop 用复合形容词 hands-on，拼写有 s 和连字符。

grammar: n. 实验；试验。可数名词；v. 做实验，常用 experiment on/with。
collocations: conduct an experiment; a science experiment; experiment with a method
commonMistake: experiment 作名词时常与 conduct/do 连用；experiment 是动词时通常用 with/on，别漏介词。

example.english: The students designed an experiment to compare two kinds of soil.
example.chinese: 学生们设计了一项实验来比较两种土壤。

application.prompt: The class will ___ with different amounts of water to see how seeds grow. A. experience B. experiment
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；experiment with 表示“用不同水量做实验”，符合科学探究语境。

grammar: phr. 查阅；检查（信息）。宾语是代词时置于 look 与 up 之间。
collocations: look up a word; look the date up; look it up online
commonMistake: look up sth 表示查找资料；代词作宾语必须说 look it up，不说 look up it。

example.english: I looked up the word in a dictionary before using it in my essay.
example.chinese: 我在作文里使用这个词之前先查了词典。

application.prompt: Which sentence places the pronoun correctly in look up? A. Please look it up in the dictionary. B. Please look up it in the dictionary.
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；代词 it 作宾语时放在短语动词中间，look it up 表示查阅它。

grammar: n. 词典；字典。可数名词，复数 dictionaries。
collocations: a bilingual dictionary; look sth up in a dictionary; dictionary entry
commonMistake: dictionary 是可数名词，辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数写 dictionaries。

example.english: The dictionary gives an example sentence for every new word.
example.chinese: 这本词典为每个生词提供例句。

application.prompt: She checked the spelling in a ___ before sending the email. A. dictionary B. diary
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；查拼写需要 dictionary（词典），diary 是日记本。

grammar: adv. 出声地；大声地。常与 read/say/speak 连用。
collocations: read aloud; say the answer aloud; think aloud
commonMistake: aloud 表示出声地让别人听见；loud 常修饰声音大小。

example.english: Reading the dialogue aloud helped Noah notice the missing word.
example.chinese: 把对话朗读出来帮助诺亚发现了漏掉的词。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses aloud correctly? A. The class read the dialogue aloudly. B. The class read the dialogue aloud.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；aloud 是副词，表示出声朗读；英语中不用 aloudly。

grammar: n. 对话；对白。可数名词，复数 dialogues。
collocations: a dialogue between friends; write a dialogue; dialogue in a play
commonMistake: dialogue 常用 dialogue between A and B；美式拼写为 dialog，教材拼法 dialogue 不要漏掉 -ue。

example.english: The dialogue between the two learners was about a school project.
example.chinese: 两位学习者的对话是关于一个学校项目的。

application.prompt: The play opens with a short ___ between a teacher and a new learner. A. dialogue B. dialect
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；角色之间的交谈是 dialogue；dialect 指方言。

grammar: adj. 总的；大体的；普遍的。副词 generally。
collocations: general idea; general rule; in general
commonMistake: general 作形容词修饰名词；generally 是副词，常表示“通常、一般而言”。

example.english: The teacher gave us a general idea before explaining each method.
example.chinese: 老师先给我们介绍了大致思路，然后讲解每种方法。

application.prompt: Before reading the details, write down the ___ idea of the article. A. generally B. general
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；修饰名词 idea 应用形容词 general。

grammar: phr. 总的来说；通常；总体上。用来概括一般情况。
collocations: in general, students learn; people in general; in general terms
commonMistake: in general 表示总体情况；in particular 则表示具体某一项，不能把两者意思混同。

example.english: In general, short daily practice is more useful than one long session.
example.chinese: 总的来说，每天短时间练习比一次长时间练习更有效。

application.prompt: Which phrase introduces a broad observation about learning? A. In particular, learners benefit from daily review. B. In general, learners benefit from daily review.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；in general 概括普遍情况；in particular 则强调某个具体对象。

grammar: v. 适合；有利于；n. 套装。动词常直接接人或事物。
collocations: suit sb well; suit the time; a business suit
commonMistake: suit 作动词时可直接接宾语，不说 suit for me；表示适合某人的需要也常用 suit sb。

example.english: The morning class suits learners who work in the afternoon.
example.chinese: 上午的课程适合下午要上班的学习者。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses suit without an extra preposition? A. The plan suits to Mia. B. The plan suits Mia.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；动词 suit 直接接宾语 Mia，不在宾语前加 to。

grammar: n. 速度；v. 加速；促进。过去式和过去分词可为 sped 或 speeded。
collocations: at high speed; speed up; speed a process
commonMistake: speed 作名词常与 at 连用；作动词过去式可用 sped，也可规则变化 speeded。

example.english: The learner read at a steady speed and understood every line.
example.chinese: 这位学习者以稳定的速度阅读，理解了每一行。

application.prompt: The bus had to ___ up when the road became clear. A. speed B. speedy
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；had to 后接动词原形 speed，speed up 表示加快速度。

grammar: n. 语法。通常不可数；可由 grammar book/lesson 表示教材或课程。
collocations: English grammar; grammar rule; study grammar
commonMistake: grammar 通常指语法体系，不加复数；具体规则可说 grammar rules。

example.english: Good grammar makes the instructions easier to understand.
example.chinese: 语法正确能让说明更容易理解。

application.prompt: We reviewed English ___ before writing the dialogue. A. grammars B. grammar
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；此处 grammar 指语法知识，通常作不可数名词。

grammar: n. 播客；播客节目。可数名词，复数 podcasts。
collocations: listen to a podcast; podcast episode; record a podcast
commonMistake: podcast 是可数名词，前面可用 a；节目内容的一集可称 an episode。

example.english: Our class made a podcast about ways to protect the valley.
example.chinese: 我们班制作了一期关于保护山谷的方法的播客。

application.prompt: Lena downloaded a ___ about pronunciation to listen to on the bus. A. podcast B. passport
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；在公交上收听发音节目的音频内容是 podcast。

grammar: num. 零；n. 最低程度或零点。复数可作 zeros/zeroes。
collocations: zero degrees; from zero to ten; score zero
commonMistake: zero 表示数值 0；在单数测量表达中常说 zero degrees，动词依实际主语决定。

example.english: The temperature fell to zero during the night.
example.chinese: 夜间气温降到了零度。

application.prompt: The test score was ___ because the answer sheet was left blank. A. zero B. tenth
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；空白答题卡没有得分，分数是 zero（零）。

grammar: phr. 偶然遇见；偶然发现。过去式 came across。
collocations: come across an old note; come across a new word; come across as
commonMistake: come across sth 表示偶然发现；come across as sb/sth 则表示“给人……印象”，要看结构辨义。

example.english: I came across a useful study method in an old textbook.
example.chinese: 我在一本旧课本里偶然发现了一种有用的学习方法。

application.prompt: While sorting her notes, Zoe ___ a flashcard she had made years ago. A. came across B. came over
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；整理时意外发现卡片用 came across，过去式为 came。

grammar: phr. 逐步地；循序渐进地。作副词性短语。
collocations: learn step by step; explain it step by step; follow steps
commonMistake: step by step 描写按顺序逐渐进行；不能在 step 后加 -s 写成 steps by steps。

example.english: The guide showed us step by step how to use the online dictionary.
example.chinese: 指南逐步展示了如何使用在线词典。

application.prompt: Instead of skipping ahead, the teacher explained the experiment ___. A. steps by steps B. step by step
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；固定副词短语 step by step 表示按步骤进行，step 不变复数。

grammar: phr. 增加；加强；逐步建立。可分动词短语。
collocations: build up confidence; build up a collection; build it up
commonMistake: build up sth 可分开；代词作宾语时说 build it up，不说 build up it。

example.english: Short practice sessions build up learners' confidence over time.
example.chinese: 短时间练习会逐渐增强学习者的信心。

application.prompt: After making a mistake, she used small daily goals to ___ her confidence. A. build up B. break down
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；小目标逐步增强信心用 build up，break down 表示分解或崩溃。

grammar: adv. 积极地；主动地。形容词 active，名词 activity。
collocations: participate actively; listen actively; actively seek feedback
commonMistake: actively 是副词，用来修饰动作；active 是形容词，不能放在动词后直接表示“积极地”。

example.english: He actively joined the discussion instead of waiting to be called on.
example.chinese: 他主动参与讨论，而不是等着被点名。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses actively to modify an action? A. The students active joined the dialogue. B. The students actively joined the dialogue.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；actively 是副词，修饰 joined；active 是形容词。

grammar: adj. 令人愉快的；有乐趣的。由 enjoy + -able 构成。
collocations: an enjoyable lesson; make learning enjoyable; enjoyable experience
commonMistake: enjoyable 描述事物带来乐趣；enjoy 是动词，不能说 an enjoy lesson。

example.english: The hands-on project made the grammar lesson enjoyable.
example.chinese: 实践项目让语法课变得有趣。

application.prompt: The class found the podcast game both useful and ___. A. enjoyable B. enjoyment
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；and 连接两个形容词 useful 和 enjoyable，描述游戏的特点。

grammar: n. 策略；方案。可数名词，复数 strategies。
collocations: a learning strategy; develop a strategy; strategy for reading
commonMistake: strategy 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数将 y 改为 i 加 -es，写 strategies。

example.english: One useful strategy is to review flashcards before going to bed.
example.chinese: 一种有用的策略是睡前复习抽认卡。

application.prompt: The teacher suggested a new reading ___ for learners who read slowly. A. strategys B. strategy
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；a new 后需单数名词 strategy，表示一种阅读策略。

grammar: v. 建议；提议；暗示。常用 suggest doing sth 或 suggest that sb do sth。
collocations: suggest a method; suggest trying again; suggest that we leave
commonMistake: suggest 后可接动名词或 that 从句；不说 suggest sb to do sth。

example.english: I suggest reviewing the new words before the experiment begins.
example.chinese: 我建议在实验开始前复习这些新词。

application.prompt: Which advice follows the usual pattern after suggest? A. I suggest him to reread the sentence. B. I suggest rereading the sentence.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；suggest 可接动名词作宾语；标准结构不用 suggest sb to do。

grammar: n. 方法；办法。可数名词；常用 method of/for doing sth。
collocations: a useful method; method of learning; try a new method
commonMistake: method 后可接 of/for 引出做事方式；不要用 method 作动词，表达“采用方法”用 use a method。

example.english: This method helps learners remember new words through short stories.
example.chinese: 这种方法通过短故事帮助学习者记住新词。

application.prompt: The teacher showed us a simple ___ for checking pronunciation. A. method B. mannerly
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；a simple 后需名词 method，表示检查发音的方法。

grammar: v. 总结；概括。英式拼写 summarise；名词 summary。
collocations: summarize a story; briefly summarize; summarize the main points
commonMistake: summarize 是动词；summary 是名词，复数 summaries。注意英式变体 summarise 仍是同一动词。

example.english: At the end of the project, each group summarized what it had learned.
example.chinese: 项目结束时，每组都总结了自己学到的内容。

application.prompt: Please ___ the main results in two sentences at the end of your report. A. summary B. summarize
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；please 后用动词原形 summarize，表示概括主要结果。

grammar: n. 成长；增加；增长。通常不可数；动词 grow。
collocations: economic growth; plant growth; growth in confidence
commonMistake: growth 是名词，grow 是动词；表示整体成长或增长时通常不加复数 -s。

example.english: Regular reading supports the growth of a learner's vocabulary.
example.chinese: 定期阅读有助于学习者词汇量的增长。

application.prompt: The young trees showed strong ___ after receiving enough water. A. growth B. grew
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；strong 后需名词 growth，表示树木的生长。

grammar: n. 思维模式；观念模式。可数名词，复数 mindsets。
collocations: a growth mindset; have a positive mindset; change one's mindset
commonMistake: mindset 是可数名词，可说 a mindset；不要和 mind（思维能力）当作完全相同的词。

example.english: A growth mindset helps learners treat mistakes as chances to improve.
example.chinese: 成长型思维能帮助学习者把错误看作进步的机会。

application.prompt: After failing the first test, Leo kept a positive ___ and tried a new strategy. A. mind B. mindset
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；积极的观念模式用 mindset，句中 a positive 修饰可数名词。

grammar: n. 材料；资料。可数或不可数，取决于指材料总称还是不同种类。
collocations: learning materials; building material; reading material
commonMistake: material 指制作物品的材料或学习资料；表示不同的材料种类可用复数 materials。

example.english: The teacher prepared extra reading material for learners who finished early.
example.chinese: 老师为提前完成任务的学习者准备了额外阅读材料。

application.prompt: Please bring the course ___, including the handout and the map. A. materials B. materialize
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；手册和地图是多份课程资料，用复数 materials。

grammar: phr. 在某种程度上；部分地。表示原因或结果并非全部。
collocations: due in part to; explain in part; be in part responsible
commonMistake: in part 表示部分原因或程度，不等于 entirely；搭配中 part 不加冠词。

example.english: The improvement was due in part to daily feedback from the teacher.
example.chinese: 这次进步部分归功于老师每天给出的反馈。

application.prompt: The project succeeded ___ because learners tested the website with real users. A. in full B. in part
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；真实用户测试是成功的部分原因，in part 表示“部分地”。

grammar: n. 指导；引导。通常不可数，常用 guidance on/in。
collocations: under a teacher's guidance; seek guidance; guidance on writing
commonMistake: guidance 通常不可数；指一位指导者用 guide，不能说 a guidance。

example.english: With guidance from her tutor, Mia corrected the pronunciation of each word.
example.chinese: 在导师的指导下，米娅纠正了每个单词的发音。

application.prompt: The learners asked their teacher for ___ on how to plan the project. A. guidance B. guide
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；for 后需要名词 guidance，表示关于项目规划的指导。

grammar: n. 反馈意见；反馈信息。通常不可数。
collocations: give feedback; feedback on a draft; useful feedback
commonMistake: feedback 通常不加复数 -s；提出多条意见时仍可说 some feedback 或 pieces of feedback。

example.english: The teacher's feedback helped me improve the second draft.
example.chinese: 老师的反馈帮助我改进了第二稿。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses feedback as an uncountable noun? A. The group received a useful feedback. B. The group received useful feedback.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；feedback 表示反馈意见时通常不可数，不加复数 -s。

grammar: n. 添加；增加；加法。可数名词，常见 in addition to。
collocations: in addition to; an addition to the team; do addition
commonMistake: addition 是名词；in addition to 中 to 是介词，后接名词或动名词。

example.english: The addition of a podcast made the course more interesting.
example.chinese: 加入播客让这门课程更有趣。

application.prompt: The ___ of a pronunciation game helped more learners join the lesson. A. addition B. additional
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；The 后需名词 addition，表示加入游戏这一行为。

grammar: phr. 另外；此外。用于补充信息，常置于句首并加逗号。
collocations: in addition, we need; in addition to the cost; add in addition
commonMistake: in addition 单独表示“此外”；后接名词时要用 in addition to，不能漏掉 to。

example.english: In addition, the website provides audio examples for each new word.
example.chinese: 此外，这个网站还为每个生词提供音频例句。

application.prompt: Which sentence uses In addition before a complete sentence? A. In addition to, the site provides audio examples. B. In addition, the site provides audio examples.
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；in addition 可连接完整句；in addition to 后要接名词或动名词。

grammar: n. 资源；资料。可数名词，复数 resources。
collocations: online resources; natural resources; a resource for learners
commonMistake: resource 是可数名词，单数前通常需要限定词；resources 常指多种学习或自然资源。

example.english: The website is a useful resource for students practising grammar.
example.chinese: 这个网站是学生练习语法的有用资源。

application.prompt: The library offers an online ___ for learners who cannot visit in person. A. resource B. resort
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；在线学习资料是 resource，resort 指度假胜地或求助手段。

grammar: n. 教科书；课本。可数名词，复数 textbooks。
collocations: a science textbook; textbook exercise; open the textbook
commonMistake: textbook 是合成名词，复数在中心词 book 上加 -s，写 textbooks。

example.english: The textbook includes a short dialogue at the end of each unit.
example.chinese: 这本课本每个单元末尾都附有一段简短对话。

application.prompt: Please open your English ___ to page 24 and read the example. A. textbook B. textbookly
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；English 后需要名词 textbook，指英语课本。

grammar: n. 优势；有利条件。可数名词；常用 advantage of/over。
collocations: have an advantage; advantage over others; take advantage of
commonMistake: advantage 通常作可数名词，单数前常用 an；注意 take advantage of 后接对象。

example.english: One advantage of flashcards is that they are easy to carry.
example.chinese: 抽认卡的一个优点是便于携带。

application.prompt: A small group has the ___ of giving every learner time to speak. A. advantageous B. advantage
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；the 后需要名词 advantage，说明小组学习的优点。

grammar: phr. 利用；善用（机会或条件）。后接名词或代词作宾语。
collocations: take advantage of an opportunity; take advantage of resources; take full advantage of
commonMistake: of 是介词，后接名词或动名词；此短语也可含“占便宜”之意，需根据语境判断。

example.english: We took advantage of the quiet room to record our podcast.
example.chinese: 我们利用安静的房间录制了播客。

application.prompt: The learners ___ the free website to practise pronunciation after class. A. took advantage of B. took advantage for
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；take advantage of sth 表示善用资源，此处指利用免费的网站。

grammar: adv. 高效地；效率高地。形容词 efficient，名词 efficiency。
collocations: work efficiently; use time efficiently; run efficiently
commonMistake: efficiently 是副词，用来修饰动词；efficient 是形容词，不能说 work efficient。

example.english: The group used the dictionary efficiently by checking several words at once.
example.chinese: 小组通过一次查多个词，高效地使用了词典。

application.prompt: With a clear plan, the class finished the experiment more ___. A. efficient B. efficiently
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；more 后修饰动词 finished，用副词 efficiently。

grammar: n. 山谷；溪谷。可数名词，复数 valleys。
collocations: a river valley; deep in the valley; valley floor
commonMistake: valley 以辅音字母加 y 结尾，复数 y 改 i 加 -es，写 valleys。

example.english: A small school in the valley uses solar power to run its website.
example.chinese: 山谷里的一所小学校使用太阳能运行网站。

application.prompt: The river flows through a narrow ___ between two high hills. A. valley B. volume
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；两座高山之间的低地是 valley（山谷）。

grammar: n. 发音；读音。通常不可数；动词 pronounce。
collocations: correct pronunciation; pronunciation of a word; practise pronunciation
commonMistake: pronunciation 是名词，拼写中没有 pronounce 的字母 o；动词 pronounce 不能代替名词。

example.english: The podcast gives a clear pronunciation of each new term.
example.chinese: 这档播客清晰地读出了每个新术语。

application.prompt: The dictionary includes an audio guide to the ___ of difficult words. A. pronounce B. pronunciation
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；the 后需要名词 pronunciation，表示单词的读音。

grammar: v. 点击；发出咔嗒声；n. 咔嗒声。过去式 clicked。
collocations: click on a link; click the button; hear a click
commonMistake: 表示点击按钮时 click 可直接接宾语；click on a link 中 on 不能漏，但不说 click at the button。

example.english: Click the blue button to open the school's project website.
example.chinese: 点击蓝色按钮打开学校项目网站。

application.prompt: To hear the example, ___ on the small speaker icon beside the word. A. click B. click at
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；click on 是点击图标的搭配，此处 on 后接图标。

grammar: n. 报纸。可数名词，复数 newspapers。
collocations: read a newspaper; newspaper article; local newspaper
commonMistake: newspaper 是可数名词；说“在报纸上”常用 in the newspaper，不用 on the newspaper。

example.english: The newspaper published an article about the learners' science project.
example.chinese: 报纸刊登了一篇关于学习者科学项目的文章。

application.prompt: Her interview appeared in the local ___ on Saturday morning. A. news B. newspaper
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；刊登采访的出版物是 newspaper；news 是不可数的新闻内容。

grammar: n. 杂志；期刊。可数名词，复数 magazines。
collocations: a science magazine; magazine article; monthly magazine
commonMistake: magazine 指定期出版物；newspaper 通常每日或每周报道新闻，二者出版形式不同。

example.english: He found an experiment idea in a children's science magazine.
example.chinese: 他在一本儿童科学杂志里发现了一个实验点子。

application.prompt: The school library subscribes to a ___ about technology and learning. A. magazine B. manuscript
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；图书馆订阅的定期刊物是 magazine（杂志）。

grammar: n. 架子；搁板。可数名词，复数 shelves。
collocations: on the shelf; a bookshelf; shelf space
commonMistake: shelf 复数为 shelves，f 变 v 后加 -es；不要写 shelfses。

example.english: I put the dictionary back on the shelf after checking the word.
example.chinese: 查完这个词后，我把词典放回了架子上。

application.prompt: The teacher placed the flashcards on two ___ near the door. A. shelfs B. shelves
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；shelf 的常见复数形式是 shelves。

grammar: phr. 打开；开放；开辟（机会或空间）。可分动词短语。
collocations: open up a shop; open up opportunities; open it up
commonMistake: open up 可表示打开空间或带来机会；代词作宾语时置于 open 与 up 中间。

example.english: The new website opened up more chances for learners to practise English.
example.chinese: 新网站为学习者创造了更多练习英语的机会。

application.prompt: The school library's new online service will ___ learning opportunities for remote students. A. open up B. close down
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；open up opportunities 表示开辟学习机会，与远程学生受益的语境相符。

grammar: v. 打印；印刷；n. 印刷品。过去式 printed。
collocations: print a document; print out a page; in print
commonMistake: print 作动词直接接要打印的内容；printout 作名词或 print out 作短语动词，注意词性。

example.english: Please print the project notes before the group meeting.
example.chinese: 请在小组会议前把项目笔记打印出来。

application.prompt: The teacher asked us to ___ the final report and bring a copy. A. printer B. print
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；asked us to 后接动词原形 print，表示打印报告。

grammar: n. 电子书。可数名词，复数 e-books。
collocations: download an e-book; e-book reader; read an e-book
commonMistake: e-book 前常用 an，因为字母 e 的读音以元音音素开头；拼写保留连字符。

example.english: I downloaded an e-book about the history of the universe.
example.chinese: 我下载了一本关于宇宙历史的电子书。

application.prompt: She read an ___ on her tablet during the train ride. A. e-book B. e-booking
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；在平板上阅读的是电子书 e-book，an 与其开头读音搭配。

grammar: n. 学校作业；课业。通常不可数。
collocations: finish schoolwork; schoolwork load; do schoolwork
commonMistake: schoolwork 通常作不可数名词，不说 schoolworks；具体一项作业可说 an assignment。

example.english: He finished his schoolwork before listening to the podcast.
example.chinese: 他听播客之前先完成了学校作业。

application.prompt: After dinner, Mina spent an hour doing her ___. A. schoolworks B. schoolwork
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；schoolwork 表示课业时通常不可数，不加 -s。

grammar: adj. 最近的；近来的。副词 recently。
collocations: recent changes; in recent years; a recent study
commonMistake: recent 是形容词，修饰名词；recently 是副词，常放在完成时或句末。

example.english: A recent study found that short breaks can improve concentration.
example.chinese: 最近的一项研究发现，短暂休息能提高注意力。

application.prompt: The website lists the ___ changes to the school timetable. A. recent B. recently
application.solution: A。解析：A 正确；修饰名词 changes 需要形容词 recent。

grammar: abbr. 汉语水平考试（Hanyu Shuiping Kaoshi），面向中文学习者的标准化考试。
collocations: take the HSK; prepare for the HSK; HSK test level
commonMistake: HSK 是专有缩写，字母全大写；不在缩写内部插入句点，也不加撇号表示复数。

example.english: Lena is preparing for the HSK to measure her Chinese language ability.
example.chinese: 莉娜正在准备汉语水平考试，以检验自己的中文能力。

application.prompt: Lena is learning Chinese and has registered for the ___, a standardized test of Chinese proficiency. A. IELTS B. HSK
application.solution: B。解析：B 正确；HSK 是汉语水平考试，句中明确说明是中文能力标准化考试。
